articles.title: Shipping & Delivery
articles.content: Standard delivery usually takes 3–5 business days. Express delivery usually takes 1–2 business days.

articles.title: International Shipping
articles.content: Bookly ships to Finland. International delivery to Finland typically takes 5–8 business days.

articles.title: Returns & Refunds
articles.content: Changed-mind returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery when eligible. Refunds for changed-mind returns are issued to the original payment method after Bookly receives the item.

articles.title: Gift Cards
articles.content: Bookly gift cards can be purchased online, redeemed at checkout, and checked for remaining balance.

articles.title: Contact Us
articles.content: For questions not covered by the Help Centre, use the Contact Us form at /contact to reach the customer care team.
